items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 69:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the power of growth? It is known that at the time that the upper attains his GAR of the greatness and raises his AHP, also his lower, whose GAR and eyes are attached to the AHP of the upper, also receives a share of that coupling that the upper receives in the upper of the upper. For example, at the time that ZA attains the GAR of the Neshama in his ascent as MAN to Aba and Ima, here also the GAR and eyes of the Nukva are attached to the AHP of ZA, and therefore the Nukva also attains her share with the stature of Neshama that ZA receives in his inclusion in Aba and Ima, which is discerned as the aspect of the first MAN of the Nukva, as above in Part 9. But the Nukva cannot receive her share in the stature there in Aba and Ima, for they are the aspect of the upper of the upper of her. Therefore ZA takes there, as a deposit, the share of the Nukva, in the secret of the firstborn who takes a double portion. And afterwards, when he descends from there and comes to his place, he returns to the Nukva the share of her stature that he received on her behalf. See there. And this is discerned in that at the time that Aba and Ima grew ZA, namely at the time that they bestowed to him his greatness, at that time they also gave in ZA the power of growth for the sake of Malchut. (Item 2).
